messages:
Marcos: hey team — running into a travel delay, gate closed. I need someone to take primary for the next ~4h. I can stay secondary if needed but won’t be able to respond as quickly. sorry for the short notice :grimacing:
Anya R: @Marcos ok — where are you in the handoff checklist? do you have any active pages or mitigation running?
Marcos: no active mitigation right now. last page was a noisy spike on embeddings-prod ~40m ago, I left a note in the runbook and cleared the alert. pinned runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff#embeds
Samir: I can take primary for the window. current pager rota shows me as standby in 2hrs but I can swap now. @oncall-bot will we need to update schedule?
oncall-bot: schedule-change-request received: requester=Samir, replacing=Marcos, start=3087654340, reason="short-notice travel". To confirm, primary must acknowledge with `/ack-primary` within 15m.
Samir: /ack-primary — taking it now. I’ll set up forwarding for critical pages to my phone.
Anya R: Samir awesome, can you double-check group routing for the inference-prod-critical rule? We had one routing hiccup last week where DMs didn’t go out.
Samir: checking... `curl -s https://infra.internal/route-configs/inference-prod-critical | jq .targets` shows ["primary","secondary","pager-duty"] — looks correct. Also re-enabled our sms-hook: `deploy sms-hook v2.1` and it returned OK in logs.
Li Chen: quick heads-up — metrics show a small telemetry gap for kv-cache hit rates between 13:05-13:10 UTC (5m). not sure if related, but flagged a quiet alert. normalized now.
Marcos: added a note in the thread with the exact commands I ran for the embeddings spike:```bash
# cleared noisy alert
rwctl alerts mute --id=embeds-prod-noisy-1742 --duration=5m
# validated model pool
rwctl pool status --pool=embeds-gpu-2
```
Anya R: Samir, since you’re swapping in, follow the handoff steps 1-5 in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff#steps — especially step 3 (check telemetry dashboards + run `rwctl health infer-prod`).
Samir: done. health check returned OK but noticed slightly elevated p95 latency for text-gen on us-west-2 for sequences >1024. I’m going to enable the fallback model-route for high-latency traces just in case: `rwctl route set --service=text-gen --fallback=gm-lt-q4_8b`
oncall-bot: routing change requested by=Samir for service=text-gen, fallback=gm-lt-q4_8b. Approval required from secondary or infra oncall within 10m.
Li Chen: approving routing change — looks good to me. go ahead Samir.
Samir: applied. will monitor traces and token cost. setting up a short 30m watch window and escalating to pager if errors >0.5% sustained.
incident-bot: Note: small incident created ID=INC-2026-307, severity=low, summary="Transient p95 latency increase us-west-2 text-gen". Linked artifacts: https://telemetry.redwood/incident/INC-2026-307
Marcos: thanks @Samir and @Li Chen. I’ll DM any travel updates but won’t intervene unless it’s urgent. Leaving a short checklist in case someone else needs to step in:
- primary contact: Samir (phone + SMS enabled)
- secondary: Marcos (limited availability)
- watch triggers: errors >0.5% or sustained p95 >800ms
- runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-incident
Anya R: noted. Samir, please post here when the watch window ends and if you promote any further fallbacks. good luck and thanks for jumping in :thumbsup:
Samir: will do. starting monitoring now. ping me for any handover at end of window, I can keep primary until 17:30 UTC if needed.
Marcos: thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick swap. logging this in rotation calendar as a one-off swap.
Samir: watch window ended — p95 and errors back to baseline. ending manual watch at 3087654489. handing back to Marcos? (confirm if you want to take primary back when you’re available)
Marcos: I’m back online and available to resume primary. taking back now. /ack-primary
